transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Since the V-12 vision-inspection station commissioning is scheduled for this weekend, I'd like to get our pre-work review started. We need to check in with maintenance, quality, and safety before I can approve the work order. I also want to discuss whether we're leaning toward Cell 3 or Cell 7 for the installation — both produce parts from the same product family, so I'd like to hear any preferences or concerns before we finalize that decision.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to share some important findings from my fit-up check on the V-12 station. The camera mount aligns only with Cell 7's 6 mm bracket pattern — it won't fit Cell 3. Installing at Cell 7 requires exactly 4 hours and isolation of exactly 3 electrical points. I recorded all these measurements in the weekend commissioning file, but it's still awaiting engineering signoff and hasn't been added to the work-order summary yet, so this information may not have reached everyone.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag something important from the quality side. I reviewed the customer validation appendix this morning, and release requires exactly 30 signed reference samples followed by challenge testing on exactly 100 consecutive production pieces. The quality checklist has not yet been revised because the customer appendix is still being attached to the change record, so if we proceed this weekend, we need to make sure these validation requirements are built into the commissioning plan.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to share a critical safety finding from my walkdown of the V-12 station. The access-door interlock must be tested through exactly 6 open-and-trip cycles before commissioning, and the results must be recorded in an interlock test record. The permit draft is currently waiting for my walkdown notes and does not yet contain this required test count, so we need to make sure this gets incorporated before the work order is approved.
transcript.speaker: A4
